Gorham, New Hampshire · eat

Restaurants in Gorham for cyclists

Where to eat in Gorham the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Mt. Washington Auto Road Bicycle Hillclimb.

Restaurants in Gorham for cyclists, listed

  1. Nonna's Kitchen

    Italian · 19 Exchange Street, Gorham, NH 03581

    Scratch Italian in a casual room; dinner from 4 PM, Wednesday to Sunday in season.

  2. J's Corner Restaurant & Lounge

    American, seafood, steaks · 277 Main Street, Gorham, NH 03581

    Village standby on Main Street with a full bar, open 11 to 9.

  3. The Butcher's Daughter

    Butcher shop, deli, prepared foods · 152 Main Street, Gorham, NH 03581

    Local meats, deli and prepared meals for a cabin or the drive home.

  4. White Mountain Cafe & Bookstore

    Coffee, cafe · Main Street, Gorham, NH 03581

    Coffee and a bookstore on Main Street for the morning before the climb.
